# remark-math monorepo license fallback provenance

The npm packages listed below declare the MIT license but publish only their
package source files, without the monorepo-root `license` file. This
directory preserves that complete upstream license so the compiled application
can ship the required copyright and permission notice.

- npm package: `rehype-katex@7.0.1`
- npm `gitHead`: `88a9497e1ede93b958237c85edbf5651faeca7af`
- immutable commit: https://github.com/remarkjs/remark-math/commit/88a9497e1ede93b958237c85edbf5651faeca7af
- package source: https://github.com/remarkjs/remark-math/tree/88a9497e1ede93b958237c85edbf5651faeca7af/packages/rehype-katex
- license source: https://github.com/remarkjs/remark-math/blob/88a9497e1ede93b958237c85edbf5651faeca7af/license

## remark-math 6.0.0

- npm package: `remark-math@6.0.0`
- npm `gitHead`: `d5d0660b150810a535bbb07eac6cc96a4510aa24`
- immutable commit: https://github.com/remarkjs/remark-math/commit/d5d0660b150810a535bbb07eac6cc96a4510aa24
- package source: https://github.com/remarkjs/remark-math/tree/d5d0660b150810a535bbb07eac6cc96a4510aa24/packages/remark-math
- license source: https://github.com/remarkjs/remark-math/blob/d5d0660b150810a535bbb07eac6cc96a4510aa24/license

The repository-root license is byte-for-byte identical at both pinned commits.
`LICENSE` in this directory is an unmodified copy of that text. The fallback is
strictly version-scoped; a package upgrade requires a fresh provenance review.
